args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and began failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all three regions now run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the unhealthy deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0.
